title: Nanjing Hides Jiangnan's Biggest Palace Complex — Temple, Palace or Museum? | China Travel Expert
description:
Everyone crowds the Forbidden City — but the largest surviving traditional-architecture complex in all of Jiangnan (southern China) is hiding in plain sight in Nanjing.

It's called Chaotian Palace. It was built as an imperial palace in the Ming dynasty, its roots reach back over 1,000 years to a Taoist temple on the same hill, and today its red walls and halls house the Nanjing Municipal Museum. Palace, temple, museum — it has been all three, which is exactly what makes it worth a detour from the big-name sites.

🧭 Expert Tip: come on a weekday. The courtyards and exhibition halls stay calm, while weekends fill up fast.
